title: I just launched Aurelia Spes: one place to backtest, walk-forward, paper-trade and code-check a trading idea. Feedback welcome
author: aureliaspes
selftext:
Aurelia Spes has four tools in one account:

* **Backtest Lab:** 8 built-in strategies or your own code, 6 index presets or your own CSV, walk-forward testing, with fees and slippage on every trade
* **Forward Testing:** point TradingView alerts at a private webhook and each signal is paper-traded live, with a stop, a daily loss cap and a kill switch. Nothing goes to a broker
* **Speak Financially:** an AI analyst that reads live news and data, cites dated sources and writes out the maths. It won’t give buy or sell calls
* **Compliance Check:** paste Python, Pine Script, MQL or C# and get RED, YELLOW or GREEN on conduct rules, market abuse, risk management and kill switch, with fix code

You don’t need code to start, and your first check or backtest is free without a card: [aureliaspes.com](http://aureliaspes.com)

Which of the four would you actually use, and what’s missing?

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
Compliance Check is the one I'd single out, because it's the only one of the four that grades Pine Script or MQL as RED, YELLOW or GREEN. What I'd miss is which rulebook it scores against: a GREEN on conduct rules and market abuse means little to a trader until they know whose rules those are. Backtesting and paper trading compete with tools traders already use; the compliance grading is the part they won't have seen elsewhere.
